title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.21767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate modeling of sea ice concentration (SIC) evolution is essential for polar climate assessment and short?range sea ice prediction. Numerical and data-driven approaches constitute major foundations for SIC modeling, but the former often require complex parameterizations and substantial compu?tation, whereas the latter rarely encode physical dependencies explicitly. translated_title: 物理知识引导的混合神经网络学习用于北极海冰浓度演变与短期预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.21767v1 公告类型：新 摘要：准确模拟海冰浓度（SIC）演变对于极地气候评估和短期海冰预测至关重要。数值方法和数据驱动方法是SIC建模的主要基础，但前者通常需要复杂的参数化和大量的计算，而后者很少显式编码物理依赖关系。本研究提出了物理信息混合冰模型（PIHIM），这是一种可微分的、数据驱动的混合冰模型，用于每日SIC演变，其根据海冰连续性方程中编码的物理依赖关系组织网络结构，并显式考虑动力输运、热力学驱动的面积增长和损失，以及未解析的局地过程。PIHIM保留了深度学习的表征能力，同时提供了冰位移、冻融面积变化和局地误差闭合的过程分解公式。两项评估...
tldr: 本文提出了PIHIM模型，该模型将海冰连续性方程的物理依赖显式嵌入深度学习网络结构，实现了过程分解的北极海冰浓度演变预测，兼顾了表征能力与物理可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PIHIM, a hybrid model that explicitly embeds physical dependencies of the sea ice continuity equation into a deep learning architecture, enabling process-decomposed Arctic sea ice concentration evolution prediction with both representational power and physical interpretability.
